definition.functional_pass: complete 25-box, 15-cycle task with successful MoveIt/FCL replay validation
definition.screen_pass: selected high-risk pickup groups only; never counted as complete success
definition.degraded: functional pass with task or whole-body bridge planning at or above the 3-second target
definition.maximum_claim: largest tested range, not a mathematical proof for unsampled interior points
